title: Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2611.32900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the condition

translated_title: 面向具身视觉跟踪的运动条件世界建模
translated_abstract: 世界模型通过预测未来环境状态来支持具身决策。在具身视觉跟踪任务中，不确定的目标运动与机器人自身引起的视角变化共同影响视觉观测，使得未来状态预测极具挑战性。我们提出运动条件世界建模，将预测的目标运动分布与机器人自运动融入潜在状态转移中。所提出的几何-进度模块通过共享运动模式和路径条件化的进度分布，联合建模几何路径与单步行进距离。这一建模方式在捕捉路线选择与运动进度中的不确定性的同时，保持了二者之间的依赖关系。由动作引起的坐标变换将预测路径表示在下一时刻的机器人坐标系中，为未来视觉状态预测提供了具有几何依据的条件。未来视觉特征重建通过该条件对运动预测器进行监督。
tldr: 提出运动条件世界建模框架，将目标运动分布与机器人自运动融入潜在状态转移，并通过几何-进度模块联合建模路径选择与运动进度的不确定性，为具身视觉跟踪提供几何一致的未来视觉状态预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes Motion-Conditioned World Modeling that incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions, with a Geometry-Progress module jointly capturing route selection and motion progress uncertainty for geometrically grounded future visual-state prediction in embodied visual tracking.
